scope: Independent source review of native receiving and optional governed-host probe
proof_checks: Exact ignored test name and nonzero-test success required
Child exit and standalone structured proof required
Exact saved native bytes pass ordinary reducer and registered controller
Actual laid-out link hit-testing retains same-node destination
Child and output bounded; process killed/reaped on failure
evidence_boundary: Ordinary fetch helper -> typed outcome -> product correlation/reducer/controller. Stop proves late-result rejection. Does not qualify fetch actor dispatch/concurrency, transport cancellation, a window, GPU presentation, independent readers or radio.
client_policy: Public validation order, settings/defaults/caps/deadlines unchanged; SDK receipt proves complete Retinue source and registry closure equality
